_comment: Tool pins for layout/. 'klt.pin' is the exact klayout-tools release used for the layout/smoke/ DRC+LVS toolchain smoke test; layout/smoke/README.md records what it was run against. 'pa_drc.pin' is the release used for the PA DRC in layout/reports/ and differs on purpose: 0.7.0's sg13g2 deck lacked the square-contact selection on cont.width.1/cont.space.1 and reported the PDK's npn13G2 bar contacts as violations (see manifests/README.md, 'T1 item 3'). Same pin as layout/pa/generate.sh and the signoff workflow. klt is run through a throwaway uvx environment, never a host install.

pa_drc.why_not_klt_pin: klayout-tools 0.8.0 added layer_selection="squares" to the sg13g2 deck's cont.width.1/cont.space.1, mirroring the foundry runset's cont_sq derivation; 0.7.0 measured the PDK's contact bars with the square-contact rule. See manifests/README.md, 'T1 item 3'.
